name: RSDP NEW User Signup Bonus Discount
author: compu245

sections.description:
The RSDP NEW User Signup Bonus Discount plugin automatically applies a discount to new users if they haven’t placed their first order. This is a great way to encourage new customers to make their first purchase! The discount amount can be customized by the site admin via the plugin’s settings page.

Key Features:
* Automatically applies a discount to a user’s first order.
* Admin can set and change the discount amount.
* Easy-to-use settings page for managing discount rules.
* Sends an email notification to info@varanasiwebdesign.com when the plugin is activated, providing the site URL and admin’s email.

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in the WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and select the downloaded zip file.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  5. Configure the discount amount by going to RSDP Signup Discount in the admin menu.
sections.faq:
How can I change the discount amount?

Go to RSDP Signup Discount in the WordPress admin menu, and you can modify the discount amount from the settings page.

Does this discount apply to all users?

No, the discount is applied only to users who haven’t placed their first order.

How does the email notification work?

Upon plugin activation, an email is sent to info@varanasiwebdesign.com with the site URL and the admin email address.
